selection: Original-language references and authored educational definitions. No translations, poems or stories as filler. Exercise wording is separately labeled teacher-generated, not an author quotation.

sources.language: Unicode metadata; not a spoken language

packets.locator: ASCII capital Latin letters, original Unicode character names and lowercase mappings
Part I, section 2: definition of noun
Book I, section I, paragraph 5: number-word table
Book I, section I, paragraph 6: written numerals and number names
Part II, section 340: subject and predicate

inspection: Exact source catalogs, authorship, original language, rights statements, private file hashes and the selected definition/table lines were checked. Full books are not represented as exhaustively reviewed. Historic grammar generalizations are not universal laws for all languages.
fetch_policy: The teacher may fetch only these exact HTTPS URLs anonymously, maximum 3 MB per source, with the recorded fingerprint. Missing or changed sources are reported; no paywall, authentication, unreviewed crawl or invented source is allowed. Later-language sources require their own reviewed entries.
